new_articles.title: ‘It’s OK to mess around’: how ‘mop man’ stole the show at Glasgow’s Commonwealth Games
new_articles.summary: CJ CheilJedang 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 '‘It’s OK to mess around’: how ‘mop man’ stole the show at Glasgow’s Commonwealth Games'이다. CJ Miller from West Lothian has delighted global audiences with ‘sheer stupidity’ of his half-time dances The 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow have already provided plenty of highlights. But fans across the world have been dazzled by one particular breakout star: the “mop man”. When a cleaner came out at half-time during a netball match to wipe down the court before the restart, everything appeared normal. But as the cleaner swept, and the first bars of Queen’s I Want to Break Free rang out in the venue, he went from sweeping to a standing split. Continue reading. .

Market participants want answers to a far bigger question than last quarter's profitability: Is the pace of AI infrastructure spending sustainable?
